periods.summary: Kanata attends Ikki's victory party and intentionally approaches Rinna. Having experienced real anti-Rebellion operations through special summons, she does not want to meet acquaintances on a battlefield. When Rinna refuses in chuunibyou fashion, Kanata reveals that the publisher of Rinna's beloved manga is tied to the Tokutomiya group and pretends to arrange its cancellation if Rinna remains on a dark path. The tactic works immediately and Rinna begs her not to cancel the series.

key_events.summary: Uses publishing leverage to make Rinna abandon future Akatsuki/Rebellion participation.
